passages.text: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
The LORD saves us.
The LORD is strong like a rock.
Let us come together.
Let us sing for joy to the LORD.
Let us shout to the Rock who saves us.
passages.original: לְ֭כוּ נְרַנְּנָ֣ה לַיהוָ֑ה נָ֝רִ֗יעָה לְצ֣וּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
He is a great God.
He is a great King above all gods.
Let us come before Him with thanksgiving.
Let us sing to Him with joy.
Let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
passages.original: נְקַדְּמָ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּתוֹדָ֑ה בִּ֝זְמִר֗וֹת נָרִ֥יעַֽ לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
passages.sermon: The LORD is a great God.\r\nThe LORD is a great King.\r\nThe LORD is greater than all other gods.
passages.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ל גָּד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וּמֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝ד֗וֹל עַל־ כָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: In His hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to Him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is a great God.
He is a great King above all gods.
He holds the deepest parts of the earth in His hand.
The highest mountain peaks belong to Him.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ וְתוֹעֲפ֖וֹת הָרִ֣ים לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is a great God.
He is a great King above all gods.
The sea belongs to Him.
He made the sea.
His hands formed the dry land.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁר־ ל֣וֹ הַ֭יָּם וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑הוּ וְ֝יַבֶּ֗שֶׁת יָדָ֥יו יָצָֽרוּ׃

passages.text: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our Maker.
He created us.
Let us come before Him.
Let us worship Him.
Let us bow down to Him.
Let us kneel before Him.
passages.original: בֹּ֭אוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֣ה וְנִכְרָ֑עָה נִ֝בְרְכָ֗ה לִֽפְנֵי־ יְהוָ֥ה עֹשֵֽׂנוּ׃

passages.text: For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture, the sheep under His care. Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, in the day at Massah in the wilderness, where your fathers tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work.
passages.sermon:
God is our God.
We belong to Him.
We are His people.
He cares for us like a shepherd cares for his sheep.
He watches over us.
He provides for us.
Today, you can hear His voice.
Listen to Him.
Do not harden your hearts.
Do not resist Him.
Do not act as your ancestors did at Meribah.
Do not be stubborn as they were at Massah in the wilderness.
There, your fathers tested Me.
They tried Me.
They saw My works.
They still doubted Me.
passages.original: כִּ֘י ה֤וּא אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַ֣ם מַ֭רְעִיתוֹ וְצֹ֣אן יָד֑וֹ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אִֽם־ בְּקֹל֥וֹ תִשְׁמָֽעוּ׃ אַל־ תַּקְשׁ֣וּ לְ֭בַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָ֑ה כְּי֥וֹם מַ֝סָּ֗ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭סּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּ֝חָנ֗וּנִי גַּם־ רָא֥וּ פָעֳלִֽי׃

passages.text: For forty years I was angry with that generation, and I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known My ways.”
passages.sermon:
God is the speaker.
God felt anger toward that generation for forty years.
God said, "These people go astray in their hearts."
God said, "They do not know My ways."
passages.original: אַרְבָּ֘עִ֤ים שָׁנָ֨ה׀ אָ֘ק֤וּט בְּד֗וֹר וָאֹמַ֗ר עַ֤ם תֹּעֵ֣י לֵבָ֣ב הֵ֑ם וְ֝הֵ֗ם לֹא־ יָדְע֥וּ דְרָכָֽי׃

passages.text: So I swore on oath in My anger, “They shall never enter My rest.”
passages.sermon: God spoke with anger.\r\nGod made a promise with an oath.\r\nGod said, “They will not enter My rest.”
passages.original: אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי בְאַפִּ֑י אִם־ יְ֝בֹא֗וּן אֶל־ מְנוּחָתִֽי׃
